description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractModuleController within the OrangeHRM system, serving as a base controller for modules. It includes a protected property for the HomePageService and a method to initialize and retrieve this service.

classes.name: AbstractModuleController
classes.description: An abstract base class for module controllers, providing a lazy-loaded instance of HomePageService.

methods.name: getHomePageService
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of HomePageService, initializing it if necessary.
